school.school_name: 長野県公衆衛生専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve a prefecture-hosted public-school support page where the latest target-form PDF is still the previous fiscal year.
search_queries: 長野県公衆衛生専門学校 高等教育等修学支援制度 様式第2号
長野県公衆衛生専門学校 令和8年度 修学支援 確認申請書
steps: Start from the Nagano official-index artifact row for 長野県公衆衛生専門学校.
Confirm the public-school support page is updated in 2025 but lists target-form documents only through the 令和７年度 section.
Open the linked 2025shinseisho2go.pdf and verify that its body contains 長野県公衆衛生専門学校, 様式第２号, and 修学支援.
Classify the case as publication lag for target FY2026 because no local page, filename, or PDF-body evidence proves a 令和8年度 target-form PDF.

reusable_rules: For prefecture-hosted public-school support pages, treat explicit annual headings such as 令和７年度 as the local scope for the following target-form links.
Keep a previous-year 様式第２号 PDF visible as operator-reviewable publication-lag evidence when the page has no current-year target-form section.
Use filename year tokens such as 2025shinseisho2go together with the page heading to avoid upgrading the latest public PDF to the current rolling target year.
anti_patterns: Do not use the page update date as target-fiscal-year evidence.
Do not let an adjacent confirmation notice or a generic support-system statement upgrade a previous-year 様式第２号 PDF to strict current-year success.
Do not count the latest public previous-year PDF as an accepted FY2026 target PDF merely because it is the newest target-form document on the page.

evidence.notes: Manual web trace on 2026-05-13 found a prefecture-hosted support page updated on 2025-07-16. The page lists 令和７年度 and 令和６年度 target-form PDFs, but no 令和８年度 target-form PDF. Source-side PDF text extraction verified 長野県公衆衛生専門学校, 様式第２号, and 修学支援 in 2025shinseisho2go.pdf; the PDF body does not contain 令和8年度, so this case must remain publication_lag_latest_public for FY2026.
